summary: Frontend-only test of redesigned customer /api/customer/login screen (Expo web export) at 390x844 and 1920x800. All 17 required data-testid elements render. Dynamic brand logo loads from /api/site/config branding.logo_light. Phone input restricts to 10 digits; invalid number shows 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number' toast. Valid 10-digit -> Send OTP transitions to step 2, otp-boxes populated with dev OTP 123456 auto-filled -> Verify OTP transitions to otp-name-step (new user). login-need-help navigates to /(site)/contact and login-back-home navigates to /(site). Desktop 1920 renders login-card at width 444, centered (left=738, right=1182) within max-width 480 column. One critical layout bug found: horizontal overflow at mobile viewport (body scrollWidth=624 at clientWidth=390).

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at 390x844: document.body.scrollWidth=624 vs clientWidth=390. The login-hero disc is absolutely positioned with right:-72*S inside a wrapper also at right:-18, width: W*0.62. The disc's own bounding box measures left=200, right=462 (right edge 72px past the 390 viewport). The outer page/ScrollView has no overflow:hidden so the body becomes horizontally scrollable. Visually content appears OK because off-screen portion is clipped by the hero circle shape, but technically fails the 'no horizontal overflow' requirement.

action_items: Fix horizontal overflow at 390 mobile: either add overflow:'hidden' to the hero min-height container (the <View style={{minHeight: Math.round(462*S)}}> wrapping HeroVisual in Customer/app/login.tsx) OR clamp the HeroVisual wrapper so its content (disc + service cards) cannot extend past the 390 right edge. Also consider setting overflow:'hidden' on the root <View style={{flex:1, backgroundColor:C.bg}}> to prevent background decorative circles from contributing to overflow if any.
critical_code_review_comments: Customer/app/login.tsx line 143: minHeight container holds absolutely-positioned HeroVisual which overflows right edge; add overflow:'hidden' to clip.

LoginParts.tsx HeroVisual: hero disc uses right:-72*S inside a wrapper already at right:-18 — effective positioning pushes disc ~90px beyond viewport right. Reduce disc negative offset or clamp parent.
Decorative circles at login.tsx lines 138-139 use large left/right negative offsets (W*0.5, W*0.6) — pointerEvents:none but still can grow document width if root lacks overflow:hidden.
test_credentials: Any 10-digit mobile; dev OTP auto-filled 123456 by backend
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes horizontal overflow, re-verify at 390x844 that document.body.scrollWidth === 390 (or <=390). All functional flows (send OTP, verify, name step, Need Help, back) already pass. Remember to rebuild Expo web after code changes: cd /app/Customer && npx expo export -p web.
rca of the issue: HeroVisual uses position:absolute with right:-72*S for the hero disc inside a wrapper placed at right:-18, width W*0.62. In Expo web these transform into DOM elements that extend past the viewport. The outer page container (<View flex:1>) and the KeyboardAwareScrollView contentContainer do not set overflow:hidden, so the body becomes horizontally scrollable (scrollWidth=624 at 390 viewport). Fix: add overflow:'hidden' to the hero section wrapper (and/or to the root View) so decorative/absolute positioned art is clipped to the viewport.
